findings.detail: Current source re-reads controller source/policy and validates actual native result; accepted object must belong to the same live controller and task.

Prospective claim is file-fsynced and directory-fsynced and exact bytes read back before native Work. Separate wall nanoseconds, observation/ingest seconds and monotonic elapsed values preserve their meanings.

Predictive source closed fields and typed Work input/result correspond to pinned public profile; one native completed result and exact Boolean marker predicate feed G3, not an external task-truth label.
Cold G3 trust recommends additional current review; source uses a correctly scoped g34:check task and original receipt bridge before selected reviewed pure Work.

The ordinary pre-open consumer and retained G4 binding revalidation use native temporal query/evaluation; age, expiry, source revision and scope mismatch preserve history. Conflict/quarantine are explicit restrictive controls, not external incident claims.
Controlled transport/AUTH/model-unscorable categories create no outcome event or negative history update. Owner scenario does not claim an actual transport failure.

Before handing off owner command, scenario must check ELIGIBLE negative feedback, verify-to-audit operation change, equal total budgets, 4/3-to-3/4 actual consumed checks and exact linked history identifiers; current source records these but does not assert them.

execution_conditions: Pin complete changed executable dependency closure before import
Use isolated synthetic finalized HTTP controller fixture with real current epoch, never owner AUTH/model/SAVE
Use one short ordinary DynamicDocumentController run, not historical multi-case Stage04 campaign
Independent reviewer must assess actual narrow test outputs before owner handoff
limitations: No new Stage04 or full E acceptance
No self-review of qualified_strategy author code
